summary: Lookout station on B.X. Mountain near Vernon by 1913, improved in 1924 and replaced by a standard structure in 1926; no source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: No source found says whether any lookout structure stands on B.X. Mountain today.
facts.agency: BC Forest Branch, Department of Lands

events.note: A lookout station was established on B.X. Mountain in 1913, per the annual report quoted on the Canada Lookouts page.
A list of new work completed in the Vernon District names a B.X. look-out cabin.
The existing lookout was substantially improved.
The old lookout was replaced with a new standard structure at a cost of $1,719.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1913 annual report places the lookout eighteen miles out of Vernon, while the Daily Colonist gives the telephone line from Vernon to the lookout as 19 miles. The two figures are not explained by the sources; the story reports both.

sources.title: B X Mountain (lookout history quoting BC Forest Service annual reports and The Daily Colonist)

notes_for_editor: Brief status, kind and access are unknown, so no status or access key is set; status_note records the gap. The only history source is a Canada Lookouts page that quotes the BC Forest Service annual reports (1913-1926) and The Daily Colonist (October 1913); the original reports were not opened. The firelookout.ca record fields are all N/A. No staffing, fire, or post-1926 source was found. Editor: the 1926 standard structure may or may not survive; a BC Archives or local history source would be the next check. Budget: two searches used.
